'''''Fighter's Courage''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] created by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] named [[Dreyba]] that was available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its foreground depicted a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who faced toward her right and wore a [[Color/Legends|black]]-hooded [[Robe/Legends|robe]], a belt, and a white [[shirt]] with red trim. The background was green and depicted the spine of a creature in white. The style and appearance of ''Fighter's Courage'' was similar to that of ''[[Warrior's Honor]]'', another painting created by Dreyba.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Fighter's Courage'' is a painting that appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', where it can be used in the player character's home as decoration. The painting was added to the game in the ''Hotfix 17.10'' game update on [[October 7]], [[2010]] as part of the "rare loot system," which allows players to obtain exceedingly rare items as loot from any enemy in the game.<ref name="SWG" />
